english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an amusing story or something said as a joke rather than seriously.

exampleSentences.english: The joke they told just now was really funny.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢頭先講嗰個笑話真係好好笑。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 tau4 sin1 gong2 go2 go3 siu3 waa6 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 siu3

english.note: Use this for a joke or something ridiculous that makes people laugh.

exampleSentences.english: This joke really makes us laugh.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu3 waa6 zan1 hai6 gei2 hou2 siu3
